# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A surge in volume accompanying a break of the opening-range high signals early institutional participation and a higher probability of continuation. This captures momentum from informed traders entering at the open, with volume confirmation reducing false breakouts.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If the price breaks above the 15-minute opening-range high on a bar whose volume is greater than 1.5× the average volume of the prior 20 bars (same time-of-day) AND the close of that bar is above the VWAP, enter long at the bar's close. Exit shape: Initial stop at the opening-range low (or 1×ATR below entry, whichever is wider); take profit at 2×risk or trail using a chandelier exit (ATR×3) once in profit. Regime hint: Best when VIX < 20 (low-volatility environment) and after 09:45 ET to avoid the first‑minute noise; avoid during major news windows (e.g., FOMC, CPI releases).
